`repair_default_enum_values(schema)` is now a public function in `ariadne/enums.py`, exported from `ariadne`. `validate_schema_enum_values` was already exported, so it is unchanged.

- **Repair function:** it walks every object and interface field argument and every input field. It turns an enum name in a default value into the Python value bound by `EnumType`. This also works through non-null wrappers, lists and nested input objects.
- **`make_executable_schema`:** it now calls the new function with only the schema. The old bindables-based function in `ariadne/executable_schema.py` is gone.
- **`set_default_enum_values_on_schema`:** I dropped the call from `make_executable_schema` and removed it from the `ariadne` exports. I left the function itself in `ariadne/enums.py`. I also left `EnumType.bind_to_default_values`, which nothing calls any more.

The full suite gives 10 failures and 614 passes, both with and without my changes. Nine of the failing tests are websocket tests under `tests/asgi/` and one is `test_init_wait_timeout_graphql_transport_ws`. I didn't add or run any new tests for the repair function.

I did not update the changelog.
